observation.visible_scene: A first-person view of a person floating in a turquoise natural pool or hot spring. The camera holder's legs and a raised right arm are visible in the foreground, while another person's legs float to the left. The background features a rocky bank, lush green ferns, and a wooden deck structure with railings.
visible_changes: The raised arm on the right side of the frame, likely holding the camera, gradually moves out of view towards the top edge.
The legs of the camera holder kick and float, shifting position slightly within the frame.
The legs of the second person on the left also float and move gently in the water.
The camera perspective shifts, changing the framing from including the raised arm to focusing more on the legs and the water ahead.
Ripples and small splashes are visible on the water surface around the moving legs.
outside_clip_unknowns: The start and end of the floating activity.
The full bodies of the individuals and their identities.
uncertain_details: Whether the arm disappearing is due to the person lowering their arm or the camera tilting down.
The exact direction and speed of the individuals' movement through the water.
